title: Excellent tour
text: Our tour with Cristina was excellent! She was prompt and our meeting was easy. Cristina was extremely welcoming, deeply knowledgeable, and super friendly- easy to talk to and ask questions She gave us terrific earpieces so we could hear every word. Our group of four all agreed it was one of the best private tours we’ve ever experienced- and we’ve done a lot of tours! Well done Cristina!!
author: Kathie_M

title: Sagrada Familia small group tour
text: Our tour of the Sagrada Familia with Anna was outstanding.  Not only is the venue breathtaking, but our visit was made that much better having a guide like Anna.  The group was small (9) making it more personal and, therefore, more entertaining.  The information received helped understand this amazing building.  Could not recommend it more.

title: Private tour with Olga
text: Wonderful experience, skipped the group lines, Olga was so wonderfully knowledgeable and personable!  Would 100% recommend!

title: Such a great experience. ...
text: Such a great experience.   Gemma was an amazing guide, she knows a lot of details and her enthusiasm was infectious.   I don't often learn so much in 90 minutes!  We had a private tour and it was wonderful,  definitely worth it for us.  Highly recommend.

title: An experienced guide makes the trip an experience for heart and mind
text:
